source.data: synthetic households (not survey data); see data/DATACARD.md

rule_format: Like the app's Rule (shared/types.ts): scope lists core ppd: terms per field (a missing field means any), effect allow or dont_allow, strictest matching rule wins. New: 'condition' on an allow rule is a PPD qualifier the compiler must send as constraints (protocol-04 7.11-7.12); origin kind 'preset'. Exactly one rule of a preset matches any flow.
